title: Brand document
description: The tenant-facing shape this package's brand resolver consumes: an opaque tenant id, a preset choice, optional colour/shape seeds, and an optional raw token override escape hatch. LIMITATION: `preset.enum` below is a manually-kept-in-sync copy of PRESET_IDS ("think", "elemetrik") from src/presets/index.ts — a static JSON file cannot import a TypeScript const, so a new preset added there does not automatically appear here (same category of limitation as the CHANNEL_BASE_ALIASES table in scripts/gen-token-names.mjs). LIMITATION: `overrides` keys are checked structurally (do they look like a CSS custom property name?) only — this schema cannot verify a key is an actual member of ROOT_TOKEN_NAMES, because that also requires the live TS array a static schema can't import; an unknown-but-well-formed token name passes here and is silently ignored by the CSS engine that consumes it.

id.description: Opaque tenant identifier, defined by the caller. No format constraint beyond non-empty.

preset.$comment: Must be kept in sync with PRESET_IDS ("think", "elemetrik") in src/presets/index.ts by hand. Adding or removing a preset there requires the same edit here.

^--[a-z0-9-]+$.description: Any valid CSS value for this custom property — a hex colour or otherwise. Value shape is not constrained; the key's membership in ROOT_TOKEN_NAMES is not verified (see top-level description).

overrides.description: Raw CSS custom-property escape hatch, keyed by name. Structural check only: keys must look like `--token-name`, but this schema cannot confirm the name is one the engine actually defines.
